note: Each case carries a 'fn' selector alongside input/want. Boundary values are chosen at the EXACT 1e3/1e4/1e6/1e7 (formatTokens) and 100/1000 (formatUSD) thresholds, plus one case just under each, since JS toFixed's own rounding can push a just-under value across the printed boundary (e.g. 9999 tokens -> '10.0K', 999999 tokens -> '1000K'). hhmm/isoOffsetMinutes read LITERAL ISO digits, never a timezone conversion — hhmmAtEpoch is the derived-epoch counterpart for values with no ISO string of their own (e.g. a projected wall-clock time). addDays/dateOnly are UTC-only, no local timezone involved.
